title: Multimodal Customer Experience Platform for Tanishq
description: An enterprise-grade Multimodal AI platform for luxury jewellery retail featuring visual similarity search, Florence & DINOv2 vision embeddings, FAISS vector indexing, and guided AI profiling.
longDescription:
Developed an advanced Multimodal AI customer engagement platform for luxury retail. The system features guided conversational recommendation, preference profiling, and intelligent visual product discovery.

• Integrated Florence and DINOv2 vision embeddings for zero-shot and high-resolution jewellery feature extraction.
• Implemented FAISS (Facebook AI Similarity Search) for sub-millisecond vector indexing and visual retrieval across thousands of product catalog images.
• Built high-performance async REST APIs using FastAPI and Python with PostgreSQL for session state, profile caching, and preference tracking.
keyFeatures: Multimodal visual similarity search using DINOv2 & Florence vision backbones
FAISS vector database index for real-time nearest-neighbor retrieval
Dynamic customer taste profiling & jewellery preference modeling
Guided LLM conversational shopping assistant
Real-time gold price feed integration & inventory schema mapping
Async FastAPI backend with sub-100ms API response latency

title: Hybrid CNN-Transformer for Skin Texture Analysis
description: Novel hybrid deep learning architecture combining convolutional feature extractors and transformer self-attention blocks to classify complex skin textures with 82% test accuracy.
longDescription:
Engineered a Hybrid Deep Learning model architecture merging Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for localized edge and texture extraction with Transformer multi-head self-attention mechanisms for global context representation.

• Designed custom augmentation and normalization pipelines to combat class imbalance and enhance out-of-distribution generalization.
• Evaluated cross-entropy loss convergence, precision, recall, and ROC-AUC curves, reaching 82% test accuracy on unseen validation splits.
• Conducted model ablation studies comparing pure CNN vs. pure Vision Transformer vs. hybrid fusion.
keyFeatures: Hybrid CNN + Vision Transformer (ViT) multi-head self-attention architecture
Custom data preprocessing, spatial augmentation, and noise filtering pipelines
Ablation studies on feature fusion layers and positional embeddings
Achieved 82% test accuracy on multi-class texture benchmarks
Comprehensive performance evaluation with ROC-AUC, confusion matrices, and loss curves

title: Oracle Cloud Enterprise AI Code Generator
description: Enterprise AI development tool transforming natural language requirements into production-ready, structured backend and cloud deployment code for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
longDescription:
Architected an enterprise-grade AI code generation engine tailored for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). The platform translates complex technical requirements into consistent, deployment-ready backend microservices and database schemas.

• Designed structured prompt engineering and contextual retrieval workflows for consistent code generation across languages.
• Created automated validation pipelines checking generated syntax, API contracts, and schema constraints.
• Built with FastAPI backend and Next.js frontend, containerized with Docker for reproducible deployment.
keyFeatures: Natural language to multi-service code generation
Context-aware Oracle Cloud service and SDK integration
Automated database schema and API route synthesis
Dockerized container execution and isolated build validation
Enterprise software architecture scaffolding

title: AI Startup Multi-Agent Simulation Engine
description: Autonomous multi-agent simulation system utilizing LLMs to simulate dynamic interactions between founders, venture capitalists, and customers to validate business models.
longDescription:
Designed and deployed an interactive multi-agent simulation platform. The system orchestrates multiple autonomous LLM agents acting as investors, adversarial customer personas, and market analysts to stress-test startup hypotheses.

• Implemented prompt orchestration for dynamic persona simulation, SWOT analysis, and financial trajectory projection.
• Built an async FastAPI backend with stateful session tracking in PostgreSQL and real-time streaming responses.
• Dockerized architecture with comprehensive unit and integration test coverage.
keyFeatures: Multi-agent autonomous LLM simulation (Founders, VCs, Customers)
Automated market validation, SWOT generation, and risk modeling
Dynamic interactive startup evolution scoring
Async FastAPI backend with streaming token responses
Stateful simulation persistence in PostgreSQL

title: Real-Time AI Sentiment Analysis Platform
description: Scalable NLP pipeline combining lexicon heuristics and Hugging Face transformer models for real-time sentiment scoring and competitive intelligence.
longDescription:
Engineered an end-to-end NLP analytics platform for continuous sentiment monitoring and opinion mining across web data sources.

• Deployed transformer-based sentiment classifiers alongside VADER lexicon analyzers for high-throughput dual scoring.
• Built automated web scraping pipelines using Scrapy and BeautifulSoup for real-time review extraction.
• Developed interactive dashboards with trend analytics and aspect-based sentiment categorization.
keyFeatures: Hybrid transformer & rule-based sentiment classification
Automated ETL and web scraping pipelines for real-time review ingestion
Aspect-based sentiment analysis and polarity trend detection
Interactive data visualization dashboards

title: AI Career Recommendation & Guidance System
description: Intelligent recommendation system using structured candidate profiling, Gemini LLM intent classification, and vector matching for career path discovery.
longDescription:
Built an intelligent recommendation system that maps user skill profiles and educational background to optimal career pathways.

• Integrated Gemini API with structured prompt templates for nuanced intent classification and semantic skill matching.
• Developed backend services in Flask / FastAPI with SQLAlchemy ORM and AWS Lambda for async analytics.
keyFeatures: LLM intent classification and candidate profile parsing
Semantic career path matching algorithm
Serverless analytics processing with AWS Lambda
Persistent user profiling and recommendations tracking

title: AI Travel Itinerary & Storytelling Engine
description: Generative AI itinerary planner that synthesizes multi-source geographical data and constraints into personalized travel schedules and narrative blogs.
longDescription:
Created an LLM-powered itinerary synthesis tool that integrates multi-source geospatial data, user preferences, and real-time constraints.

• Designed structured prompt chains for multi-day schedule synthesis, routing, and storytelling generation.
• Built automated PDF export module with custom styling for offline access.
keyFeatures: Dynamic prompt chaining for constraint-based itinerary generation
Multi-source geospatial integration with Google Maps API
Automated structured PDF itinerary generation
AI-assisted travel blog and storytelling synthesis

title: VIT-AP Student Marketplace Platform
description: Full-stack community marketplace web application enabling students to buy, sell, and trade items with real-time messaging and campus email validation.
longDescription: Developed a full-stack community marketplace for university students. Implemented secure Clerk authentication with academic domain verification, PostgreSQL (Neon) serverless database architecture, dynamic filtering, Cloudinary image upload workflows, and real-time conversation messaging.
keyFeatures: Clerk authentication with academic email domain validation
Serverless PostgreSQL (Neon) database with optimized relational schemas
Real-time student chat and conversation system
Cloudinary media upload and asset optimization pipeline
Dynamic product filtering by category, price, and campus location
